openwrt_wiki.Installation: Download the OpenWrt sysupgrade image as shown above; Flash using OEM web UI
openwrt_wiki.Back to stock firmware: Poweroff; download factory image; computer 192.168.1.X/24; press and hold reset while powering on until ALL LAN green LED turn on, release; LAN cable into LAN 1; ping 192.168.1.1; open 192.168.1.1 -> X5000R firmware update page, choose factory file; router reboots itself (blue led and green LAN led blinking); revert to automatic; itotolink.net or 192.168.0.1
openwrt_wiki.Opening the case: There are 4 screws and a lot of plastic clips. No screws behind stickers or anything.
openwrt_wiki.Serial: The serial port of the X5000R can be accessed using the TTL 3.3V pins behind the power plug connector. A voltage level converter (such as a MAX3232 TTL-RS232 dongle) is required. The communication settings are: 115200, 8N1
openwrt_wiki.TFTP: From u-boot menu option 2, the sysupgrade Openwrt firmware can be downloaded. OEM firmware can be reloaded as well. Default TFTP server address: 192.168.1.2 (other server IP can be input). Default FW file name: test.bin (other file name can be input)
OEM bootlog (Auszug): MediaTek SoC: MT7621A, RevID: 0103, RAM: DDR3, XTAL: 40MHz
Kernel command line: console=ttyS0,115200n8 root=/dev/mtdblock4 rootfstype=squashfs

Press press RST button for more than 2 seconds to run web failsafe mode
